title: Curious Urgency 58
author: bpatrick
body: I almost violated my self-imposed ban on grayscale in the long comics for this page. Maybe I should.

comments.author: Mad Whiskey grin
comments.text:
You’ll get no help with the grayscale decision from me, artist. Make your own choices!

Continued nice work. Not surprised.

comments.author: Gogo Yubari
comments.text: Don’t do it! The pure black and white is just too good.

comments.author: Joshua
comments.text: May I suggest that if you’re going to break the grayscale, you should do so at a moment of awakening/clarity/vision on the part of your plucky hero? I like this comic, I look forward to re-reading it up to what you’ve got up now. I don’t know how you keep all these different stories going at once, man, but good work.
